qualification: Implementation and synthetic regressions do not establish visual fidelity, accessibility conformance or general document accuracy. Parent visual review and the existing merge hold remain in force.

limits.additional_bounds: Existing supervised worker memory, CPU, wall time, output, process-tree cancellation and native network filter; unavailable required guards fail closed.

capabilities.verification: Every generated PDF now requires independent structural and occurrence-aware requested-text/number checks before publication. Synthetic exact numbers/text, metadata, independent rendering and source/output hashes retained.
capabilities.limits: Pinned plain-text writer does not wrap lines or embed Unicode fonts. Adapter rejects overflowing lines and non-WinAnsi text; explicit embedded-font document creation supports additional glyphs.

capabilities.verification: Headings, emphasis, numeric literals, centered headers/footers and left/centered Artifact templates independently read and rendered.
capabilities.limits: Raw HTML and resource/image/link syntax rejected; use explicit declarative links/images. Independent input-derived token counts reject detected Unicode fallback loss and clipped unwrapped content, including repeated values. Native Markdown layout remains visually unqualified.

capabilities.verification: Basic headings, emphasis and numbers checked.
capabilities.limits: Pinned API performs basic HTML-to-Markdown substitution, not browser layout. Independent entity-decoded expectations reject native literal-entity output that loses requested characters/numbers. Table elements and active/resource constructs remain blocked.

capabilities.verification: Single and two-family supplied font calls retain paragraph text/numbers on separate rendered lines. All requested glyphs checked against supplied font bytes.
capabilities.limits: Table HTML is blocked: all cells overlap in PDFium even with explicit display/width/height CSS. Script/resource HTML, external URLs/imports/font-face/paths rejected. Metadata/template combinations unsupported by pinned API are rejected. Other CSS layouts remain unqualified. Independent body-text occurrence checks reject detected hidden/missing requested text; layout remains visually unqualified.

capabilities.verification: Independent PyMuPDF count/geometry, declared minimum pages, metadata and repair-free reopen checked before publication. Content checks and bounded decoder renders are described in independent_pdf_validation; they do not certify visual fidelity. File save variants use bytes plus confined app-owned output writing.
Public Bitstream Vera fixture: accented text/numbers retained, missing CJK glyph rejected.
capabilities.limits: No arbitrary font paths. Assets capped and independently checked; upstream handles consumed once. Base-14 Symbol/ZapfDingbats encoding is not exposed by this contract.

capabilities.verification: Mixed text/inline/headings/columns/footnote/rectangle fixture independently read and rendered. Complex layout overlap and clipping remain review requirements. Independent requested token counts now reject observable off-page/column tail loss before publication; original failures are preserved.

capabilities.limits: Native measure falls back to Helvetica for embedded fonts. remaining_space is a buffered client estimate, not authoritative page layout; report explicitly labels both.

capabilities.verification: Independent vector drawing count, bounded geometry/RGB/dash validation and page renders.

capabilities.limits: Widths constrained to page content area; native wrapped/long-cell behavior still requires visual review.
capabilities.evidence: evidence/creation-visual-review/test_table_rows_numbers_and_mi0 and mi1: original output.pdf and PDFium renders; original fixture source preserved alongside.

capabilities.evidence: evidence/creation-visual-review/test_table_rows_numbers_and_mi0 and mi1: original output.pdf and PDFium renders; original fixture source preserved alongside.

capabilities.verification: Each supported symbology produces a nonblank embedded image with independent pixel decoding.
capabilities.limits: Independent payload decoding of every 1D symbology is not yet qualified; printing/scanner reliability remains unqualified.

capabilities.verification: Alpha PNG embedded twice as semantic/decorative image; image occurrences, pixels and original-byte hash checked.
capabilities.limits: Single-frame PNG/JPEG/WebP bounded embedded bytes. Unsupported format/frame count/invalid image/decoded pixel count fails. No arbitrary path or remote URL.

highlight/underline/strikeout/squiggly are blocked: malformed QuadPoints render as tiny marks. Stamp blocked: no visible PDFium appearance. Named links blocked: no pinned Python destination-creation API. Watermark fixed-font/rotation extents checked before invocation; clipping cases fail. Synthetic note icon intentionally overlays its default text anchor; explicit placement supported.
capabilities.verification: External URI and internal /Dest exact page-reference checks, note/free-text contents; PDFium-visible note icons/free-text and complete watermark samples. Glyph/layout review remains mandatory.
capabilities.evidence: evidence/creation-annotation-probe/source.json, output.pdf and page-1.png through page-11.png retain failures; evidence/creation-visual-review-selected retains working bounded samples, with no acceptance claim.

capabilities.verification: Independent field dictionary/current value checks; unsigned signature placeholder has no signature /V.
capabilities.limits: Native builder writes text defaults as /DV without /V; adapter uses pinned PdfDocument.set_form_field_value and to_bytes, then verifies current value independently. Visual form appearances still require review. Buttons have no scripts. No signing/private keys.

capabilities.reason: Pinned builder produced radio widgets without /Parent and no parent /Kids, included unnamed widgets as AcroForm.Fields, and independent reader could not render appearances or identify the Group widget. Adapter rejects before spawn; failing native output preserved.

capabilities.limits: Not certified PDF/UA accessibility conformance; screen-reader behavior and semantic structure require separate review.

capabilities.reason: Current contract deliberately refuses arbitrary embedded scripts. Full engine integration does not authorize active document code or persistent services.

Value objects are constructible, but pinned Python document/page APIs expose no rendering consumer. No arbitrary object-construction RPC or content injection is used to pretend gradient, alpha, blending, cap/join or template-style rendering exists. Pattern content generation is a separate supported standalone capability below.

Save variants use to_bytes/build then app-owned worker paths. Font file paths become bounded explicit font bytes. Encryption is owned by the separate security adapter; no password in arbitrary paths, argv or creation reports.
Source-input image-to-PDF, source PDF roundtrip and merge workflows are implemented and verified by their respective owners, not duplicated in zero-input declarations.

capabilities.verification: All eight 1D symbologies and QR produce independently rendered vector geometry; all four QR error-correction levels decode exact synthetic payload through OpenCV.
capabilities.limits: Native 1D SVG omits xmlns; exact native bytes retained as oxide-barcode-native.txt, fixed app-owned namespace added to browser SVG and transformation/hash reported. Strict geometric XML allowlist and 2MiB cap. Every 1D payload is not independently decoded; no scanner/print certification.

capabilities.verification: All six presets return bounded nonempty actual native PDF content bytes and exact input/output hashes; output explicitly states complete_pdf=false, page_pattern_applied=false.
capabilities.limits: No pinned Python method applies these pattern cells to a page. Export is the useful native helper result, not a fake rendered-page implementation. Color constructor/named-color helpers are value aliases for RGB; no individual method-complete claim.

capabilities.reason: Pinned 0.3.78 silently omits declared nonempty keywords from the PDF Info dictionary. PyMuPDF and pikepdf independently reproduce absence; publication now fails instead of claiming retained metadata.

independent_pdf_validation.status: required-before-publication; detected mismatches fail without output
structure: Independent page count agrees with native count and requested limit
All pages decoded and rendered at at most 384 pixels on longest edge; decoder warnings fail closed
content: Input-derived, case/Unicode/sign/decimal-sensitive token occurrence counts; repeated words/numbers cannot be satisfied by one occurrence
HTML entities decoded independently for expectations; metadata/head text excluded
Bounded Markdown block/emphasis/code text expectations and template literal/page/title/author substitutions
Requested metadata, image/barcode placement counts, named form types/current values/choices and sticky-note/free-text annotation contents independently checked
genuine_native_losses_reproduced: Markdown code CJK replaced by question mark
Basic HTML numeric and apostrophe entities remain literal
Long Markdown headings and small-page columns lose text outside page bounds
Off-page declarative text is not retained by page extraction
DocumentBuilder.keywords silently omitted from Info dictionary
limitations: Occurrence counts do not verify text order, spacing, page or table-cell association; extra output text is not rejected
A repeated value elsewhere can satisfy an expected token count; this is not a complete semantic comparison
Markup expectations cover the bounded supported syntax; CSS hiding body text fails closed
Date/time template substitutions are not independently reproduced
Image count/decoding do not verify pixels or barcode payloads
Form/annotation values do not verify appearance or interaction
Small renders detect decoder errors only; no visibility, clipping, overlap, table-layout, accessibility or general visual-fidelity claim
